queries: WITH m AS (SELECT max(tick) tick FROM budget_monthly), q AS (SELECT b.*, l.income_tax_rate,l.property_tax_rate,l.electricity_tariff,l.road_maintenance_budget,l.water_sewer_capex,l.transit_fare,l.zoning_release,l.power_contract_mode,p.demand_kw,p.supply_kw,p.outage_fraction,w.capacity,w.demand,w.load_ratio,mi.population,mi.net FROM budget_monthly b JOIN m ON b.tick=m.tick JOIN lever_monthly l ON l.tick=b.tick JOIN power_monthly p ON p.tick=b.tick JOIN water_monthly w ON w.tick=b.tick JOIN migration_monthly mi ON mi.tick=b.tick) SELECT * FROM q

WITH x AS (SELECT tick, avg(condition_score) avg_condition, avg(occupancy) avg_occ, avg(CASE WHEN power_served THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) outage_buildings FROM building_monthly GROUP BY tick), r AS (SELECT tick, avg(wear) avg_wear, avg(congestion) avg_congestion FROM road_monthly GROUP BY tick), c AS (SELECT tick, avg(satisfaction) satisfaction, avg(disposable_income) disposable, avg(CASE WHEN employed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) employment FROM citizen_monthly GROUP BY tick), b AS (SELECT tick,balance,debt,treasury FROM budget_monthly) SELECT b.*,x.*,r.avg_wear,r.avg_congestion,c.* FROM b LEFT JOIN x USING(tick) LEFT JOIN r USING(tick) LEFT JOIN c USING(tick) ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT tick, arrivals, departures, net, population FROM migration_monthly ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 12

WITH x AS (SELECT tick, avg(condition_score) avg_condition, avg(occupancy) avg_occ, avg(CASE WHEN power_served THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) outage_buildings FROM building_monthly GROUP BY tick), r AS (SELECT tick, avg(wear) avg_wear, avg(congestion) avg_congestion FROM road_monthly GROUP BY tick), c AS (SELECT tick, avg(satisfaction) satisfaction, avg(disposable_income) disposable, avg(CASE WHEN employed THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) employment FROM citizen_monthly GROUP BY tick), b AS (SELECT tick,balance,debt,treasury FROM budget_monthly) SELECT b.tick,b.balance,b.debt,b.treasury,x.avg_condition,x.avg_occ,x.outage_buildings,r.avg_wear,r.avg_congestion,c.satisfaction,c.disposable,c.employment FROM b LEFT JOIN x USING(tick) LEFT JOIN r USING(tick) LEFT JOIN c USING(tick) ORDER BY b.tick DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT tick, demand_kw, supply_kw, outage_fraction, contract_mode, tariff FROM power_monthly ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT tick, capacity, demand, load_ratio, failure_rate FROM water_monthly ORDER BY tick DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT b.tick,b.balance,b.debt,b.treasury,p.outage_fraction,p.demand_kw,p.supply_kw,w.load_ratio,w.failure_rate FROM budget_monthly b JOIN power_monthly p USING(run_id,tick) JOIN water_monthly w USING(run_id,tick) ORDER BY b.tick DESC LIMIT 6

WITH r AS (SELECT tick,avg(wear) wear,avg(congestion) congestion FROM road_monthly GROUP BY tick), c AS (SELECT tick,avg(satisfaction) sat,avg(disposable_income) disp FROM citizen_monthly GROUP BY tick), m AS (SELECT tick,net,population FROM migration_monthly) SELECT r.tick,r.wear,r.congestion,c.sat,c.disp,m.net,m.population FROM r JOIN c USING(tick) JOIN m USING(tick) ORDER BY r.tick DESC LIMIT 6
